svg.text: Two planes. One sidebar. Fifteen components, no exceptions. Bridges are references, never copies.
New agent = toolbar button on Agents (+ palette).
Never a nav item — nav stays navigational.
org-shared · governed · reusable — one row serves many agents
per-assistant definition — one row-set per agent · drafted by makers, published by owners
assistant_installs — copy provenance, never a live link · registry changes never touch an installed agent
targets: template · assistant · version · tool · capability — expiry evaluated at check time (no sweeper), so the UI must compute Active / Expired itself
draft references by NAME (writable payload) · publish resolves to VERSION + HASH (read-only). Never write resolved values back —
rejectUnknownPayloadKeys returns a 422 with exact key paths for effect_class, when_to_use, max_context_tokens, embedding_model, document_version.
SCOPE CLASS — WHAT AN ACTION COSTS

g.text: default styling · confirm only if destructive
writes a library row — affects every agent

svg.text: Law: an org action may be initiated from the builder — but must never look like an agent action.
Shared entities are governed on library pages, creatable inline when creation is prerequisite to attaching.
◐ SPLIT = governed on a library page · configured in the inspector · bridged by reference.
Don’t-builds: no guardrail/budget preset libraries · no instruction-snippet backend · no org template authoring UI.
VOCABULARY LOCK — nouns from the engine, verbs and descriptions ours. Warmth lives in sub-labels: Model “How it thinks.” · Knowledge “What it knows.” · Tools “What it can do.”

Retired from all user-visible copy: Blueprint · Museum · Mirror · Brain · Hands · Purpose · Context assembly · Try · Ship · Spark · Artifact · Studio · Engine Room · Fleet — permitted as internal identifiers only.
